description: Search the UMD Schedule of Classes for a term the way its search form does. Needs at least one of course_id (a department prefix, partial id or full id), instructor, or delivery; the other fields narrow the results. When the search narrows by section (instructor, days, time, delivery, open seats, credits or level) the matching sections come back inline; otherwise sections are null and testudo_soc_get_sections fetches them. No login needed.

course_id.description: Department prefix ("CMSC"), partial id ("CMSC13") or full course id ("CMSC131") to match

credits.description: Only courses whose credits satisfy credits_compare against this value, 0-4

credits_compare.description: How to compare course credits with `credits` (default "=")

days.description: Only sections that meet on these weekdays

delivery.description: Only sections taught in these ways (default: any)

end_time.description: End of the range when time_compare is "between", e.g. "3:00 PM"

instructor.description: Instructor name as testudo_soc_autocomplete_instructors returns it in `name`, e.g. "Gonzalez, Elias"

open_sections_only.description: Only sections with open seats (default false)

section_id.description: Only this section, e.g. "0101"; use together with a full course_id

start_time.description: Time for time_compare, on the quarter hour, e.g. "12:00 PM" or "9:30 AM"

teaching_center.description: Only sections taught at this location or in this program: "ALL" all locations and programs, "*" College Park campus, "DC" District of Columbia, "FS" Frostburg State, "HG" Hagerstown, "HT" Heat Center, Harford County, "RB" Reagan Building, "SG" Shady Grove, "SM" Southern Maryland, "BA" University of Maryland, Baltimore, "FC" Freshmen Connection, "PP" Professional Programs, face to face, "OF" Professional Programs, online, "LS" Science in the Evening, "SE" Universities at Shady Grove / EDUC (default "ALL")

term_id.description: Four-digit year followed by "01" (Spring), "05" (Summer), "08" (Fall) or "12" (Winter), e.g. "202608" for Fall 2026

time_compare.description: Only sections whose meetings start "after", "at" or "before" start_time, or "between" start_time and end_time

name: testudo_soc_search_courses

courses.description: Matching courses grouped by department, in catalog order

additional_information.description: The catalog's "Additional information" note; null if there is none

also_offered_as.description: The catalog's "Also offered as" note; null if there is none

corequisite.description: The catalog's "Corequisite" note; null if there is none

credit_only_granted_for.description: The catalog's "Credit only granted for" note; null if there is none

max.description: Maximum credits; equals min for a fixed-credit course

cross_listed_with.description: The catalog's "Cross-listed with" note; null if there is none

formerly.description: The catalog's "Formerly" note; null if there is none

gen_ed.description: General education requirements the course fulfills

name.description: Category and requirement, e.g. "Fundamental Studies - Academic Writing"

individual_instruction.description: true for individual-instruction courses (independent study, research) where the department must be contacted to register

notes.description: Term-specific notes for the course, e.g. special-topics blurbs or placement advice

permission_required.description: true when the department must grant permission to register

prerequisite.description: The catalog's "Prerequisite" note; null if there is none

recommended.description: The catalog's "Recommended" note; null if there is none

restriction.description: The catalog's "Restriction" note; null if there is none

instructors.description: Instructor names; empty when still to be announced

building.description: Building code, e.g. "IRB" (see testudo_soc_get_building); null for online or unassigned meetings

days.description: Days the meeting is held, e.g. ["M", "W", "F"]

end_time.description: End time as printed, e.g. "10:50am"; null if not set

room.description: Room number, e.g. "0324"; "ONLINE" for online meetings; null if unassigned

start_time.description: Start time as printed, e.g. "10:00am"; null if not set

time_on_elms.description: true when the meeting has no fixed time and the section says "Class time/details on ELMS"

type.description: "lecture" for the main meeting, else "discussion" or "lab"

notes.description: Section notes, e.g. "Restricted to students in Freshmen Connection."

seats.description: Seat counts as of the last refresh, not real time

waitlist.description: Students on the waitlist; null if not shown

sections.description: Matching sections when the search narrowed by section (instructor, day, time, delivery, open seats, credits or level); null when sections were not loaded, in which case call testudo_soc_get_sections

syllabus_count.description: Number of past syllabi in the syllabus repository (see testudo_soc_list_syllabi)

message.description: Message the site shows instead of results, e.g. that no courses matched or that the search needs more criteria; null when there are results

seats_as_of.description: When the seat counts on this page were last refreshed, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in US Eastern time (roughly hourly); null if the page does not say

title: Search courses
